engine: Official native Godot 4.7.2, Arch Linux / Wayland, NVIDIA RTX 3070 Laptop
launch_behavior: Normal launch starts at the title screen; Deploy or Enter begins. No automatic shutdown.

normal_launch.observed_screen: Live convoy gameplay; left running without further input.

GPU_benchmark.note: Live autonomous convoy and combat rendering with no other game instance running. Player is an observer outside the battlefield for this automated benchmark.
GPU_benchmark.capture_note: Frame measurements include four screenshot readbacks. Some non-capture destruction hitches remain.

systems: Live convoy, penetrable vehicles and two authored Panzerfaust strikes
Squad and group command with succession and sequential sector plans
Finite ammunition and grenades, friendly-fire avoidance without immunity
Persistent bodies and detachable parts; dropped guns retain ammunition and condition
Physical terrain pits and trenches, destructible props and falling trees
One firearm and capacity-limited ammunition containers; excess loot remains
limitations: Original procedural prototype art and simplified animations, not AAA production assets
Destruction is finite and budgeted; terrain permits pits and trenches but not tunnels or overhang excavation
AI uses coarse grid navigation and can hesitate in complex rubble; tests do not establish that it will always complete the mission
Occasional destruction hitches remain; the benchmark does not cover every possible player viewpoint
Convoy danger and combat balance require human testing
No campaign saves, multiplayer, voice acting or controller mapping

previous_desert_validation.note: Earlier 117-check desert result retained as historical evidence; this pass rechecked its menu and launcher, not all old encounter suites.
